description: Ministry of Defence - Award of Sri Lanka Armed Services Long Service Medal and Long Service Clasp
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the award of the Sri Lanka Armed Services Long Service Medal to military personnel who have completed 12 years of service. This falls under public service administration as it deals with service recognition, benefits, and awards for members of the armed forces, which is a public sector service matter. The content does not involve government structural changes, specific personnel appointments with responsibilities, or any of the specialized categories like land, legal, commercial, elections, or judicial matters.
